100581.title: Handlebar assembly overview
guidance: Inspect the finish, then position 1 EA of Stem (Product Number SM-9087) at the center of 1 EA of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) using an assumed assembly jig. The attachment details are unspecified; see illustration 100581.
Apply a total of 40 IN of HL Grip Tape (Product Number GT-2908) to the grip areas of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) as a demonstration; see illustration 100581.
Fit 2 EA of Road End Caps (Product Number EC-R098), one at each tube end. Visually check the tape, caps and overall alignment; set aside any visibly damaged assembly.
